summary: In Ansible 13, PowerShell module utilities no longer strip quotes from paths during Windows copy and fetch operations, so over-quoted paths must be fixed.
questions: Why does win_copy fail with a quoted path after upgrading to Ansible 13?
Does Ansible still remove quotes from Windows paths?

answer_card.title: No more quote stripping in Windows paths
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 13 (ansible-core 2.20), PowerShell module utilities **no longer remove quotes from paths** in Windows operations such as copying and fetching files. Normal playbooks are unaffected unless a value is quoted too many times; if you relied on automatic quote removal, fix the path formatting.
